Message ReportAnnunciatorCapabilities

Message ID: FF01h

Description:
This message provides an annunciator client with the stream formats the annunciator accepts and critical parameter values and ranges associated with each format.

ReportAnnunciatorCapabilities
AnnunciatorCapabilityList
AnnunciatorIdRec
AnnunciatorCapabilityRec

Message Format
Field # Field Type Units Optional Interpretation
1 AnnunciatorCapabilityList List false


annunciatorCapabilityList
Count Field: Unsigned Byte
Field # Field Type Units Optional Interpretation
1 AnnunciatorIdRec Record false
2 AnnunciatorCapabilityRec Record false


AnnunciatorIdRec
Field # Field Type Units Optional Interpretation
1 AnnunciatorID Unsigned Short units one false Selector specifying one annunciator device from the set of devices supported by the service. Zero is not a valid annunciatorID.


AnnunciatorCapabilityRec
Field # Field Type Units Optional Interpretation
1 MinimumBitrate Unsigned Short units one false Minimum (floor) bitrate supported by annunciator, in kilobits/sec. Constant bitrate encoding is indicated by setting minimumBitrate = maximumBitrate.
2 MaximumBitrate Unsigned Short units one false Maximum (ceiling) bitrate supported by annunciator, in kilobits/sec. Constant bitrate encoding is indicated by setting minimumBitrate = maximumBitrate.
3 MinimumSampleRate Unsigned Long units one false Minimum (floor) audio sample rate supported by annunciator, in samples/sec.
4 MaximumSampleRate Unsigned Long units one false Maximum (ceiling) audio sample rate supported by annunciator, in samples/sec.
5 SampleWidths BitField
Integer Size: Unsigned Short		 one false Sample widths supported by the Annunciator are represented by setting corresponding bits to 1.

0: EIGHT_BITS
1: TEN_BITS
2: TWELVE_BITS
3: FOURTEEN_BITS
4: SIXTEEN_BITS
5: TWENTY_BITS
6: TWENTY_FOUR_BITS
7: THIRTY_TWO_BITS
8: FOURTY_BITS
9: FOURTY_EIGHT_BITS
10: FIFTY_SIX_BITS
11: SIXTY_FOUR_BITS
6 Formats BitField
Integer Size: Unsigned Short		 one false Digital audio formats supported by the Annunciator are represented by setting corresponding bits to 1.

0: ULaw
1: AAC
2: MP3
7 EncodingQuality BitField
Integer Size: Unsigned Byte		 one false Encoding quality levels supported by the Annunciator are represented by setting corresponding bits to 1. Note that the quality levels are subjective.

0: HIGHEST
1: HIGH
2: GOOD
3: MEDIAN
4: FAIR
5: POOR
6: LOWEST
8 MaximumChannels Unsigned Byte units one false Maximum number of audio channels supported (e.g., 1 = monaural, 2 = stereo, etc.)
